pr_title: drivers: i2c: i2c_gecko: add exclusive access
pr_body:
- Add exclusive and atomic access to i2c resource

Fixes #79110
pr_comments: @jerome-pouiller @teburd no more issues related to I2C access in our project with this fix

issue_context.title: driver: i2c_gecko: add exclusive support
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Ensure exclusive access to I2C when using gecko SoCs (silabs).

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Add support for exclusive access

review_comments: I believe it should be a `k_mutex` rather than a `k_sem`.

In my initial commit, the variable was inconsistent (mutex), but the semaphore behavior is correct.
Change variable name from bus_mutex to bus_lock

Yep, and `k_sem` is almost always a better choice than `k_mutex` when it comes to locking. I recommend checking out https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vla8DTsttyA by @andyross which has lots of interesting insights regarding this.
